Ready to do a customer reference call? I can connect you with [Prague CB / German Regulator / Creator Platform].

contingency_plans.if_investor_no_shows: Send calendar reminder 24h before. If no-show: offer rescheduling + send full deck.
contingency_plans.if_low_meeting_rate: Increase outreach by 50% (10 additional warm intros). Adjust weekly targets.
contingency_plans.if_customer_reference_unavailable: Use Prague PoC video as proof (€180K ARR revenue proof attached to email).
contingency_plans.if_series_a_timeline_extends: Shift close window to Aug 31. Maintain investor momentum with fortnightly updates.

notes: All 8 investor intros personalized by sector. Use custom greeting from investor_intros[N].custom_greeting in warm intro email. Track all meetings in HubSpot. Target 4-6 LOIs by July 25. Close €10M Series A by July 30.
